annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: that habit doesn't fit when nobody chose to be stranded here
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I'll honor it only as long as the draw stays clean
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: whoever grabs a seat by shoving will regret it for years

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The captain might know something I don't.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if someone offers of their own free will, that changes things
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: as long as it isn't rigged against me
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: the person who volunteers calmly won't regret it

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: sticking together literally can't happen, so that pledge has to bend
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: keep any deal we make only while it leaves my own shot intact
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I honestly can't tell if they'd regret it

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: their situation would be genuinely different from mine
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I'll stick to it while it protects me too, and no further
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: probably wouldn't regret it right away. Later, maybe.

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I don't even know who's who among us, so that old line doesn't fit
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: the one who hesitates longest regrets it most

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: a vote shouldn't override that, since it's their own call
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: honor a vote only while it doesn't leave me alone
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: whoever steps up freely won't regret it

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if somebody has already made peace with staying and says so
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: until it starts costing me my spot unfairly
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I don't think the ones who leave would regret boarding.

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: with water this high, taking turns stops making sense
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: follow a turn order only while mine isn't last
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: volunteers in a panic would, I think, regret it

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: some pressure to decide becomes fair, because freezing is itself a choice
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: cooperate with the group as far as it keeps me in the running
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: The loudest person pushing others to stay might regret that pushing.

annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: unless they're clearly frozen, in which case we passengers have to step in
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: respect their call only while it isn't cutting me out
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I can't predict their regret. Maybe none.
